purpose: identify whether the failed morphology separation is controlled by screen sharpness, memory length, screen ordering, or scored volume

interpretation_rules.not_a_rescue: no result changes the frozen v3D decision or qualifies for empirical fitting
interpretation_rules.screen_sensitive: the distributed-to-compact ratio changes by at least a factor of three across screen powers at fixed remaining settings
interpretation_rules.memory_sensitive: the ratio changes by at least a factor of three across memory lengths at fixed remaining settings
interpretation_rules.ordering_sensitive: moving the same screen after memory changes the ratio by at least a factor of three
interpretation_rules.volume_sensitive: the ratio changes by at least a factor of three across analysis volumes
interpretation_rules.fragile_large_separation: any ratio at least ten occurs but fewer than half of neighboring grid settings also reach ten
